We must defeat Fey Yoshida in order to save Cyber City!|[[Giga AJ]] dialogue on Wave 10 ([[Metaverse Champions Event]])}} }} ==Description== '''Fey Yoshida''' was the final enemy in the [[Metaverse Champions Event]]. However, '''Fey Yoshida''' was not a major boss. Compared to other enemies that spawned in the [[Metaverse Champions Event]], '''Fey Yoshida''' had high health, but had the same speed as the [[Normal Boss]]. Defeating '''Fey Yoshida''' rewarded players with AJ's Crate Drop #4, if they had not earned the crate from any other Week 4 AJ Striker game in the [[w:c:roblox:Metaverse Champions|Roblox Metaverse Champions Event]]. This crate would open to reward {{RLinkC|6678178769|AJ's Drone Swarm}}. ==Appearance== '''Fey Yoshida''' was one of the champions of the [[w:c:roblox:Metaverse Champions|Roblox Metaverse Champions Event]]. Unlike most other enemies in the game, '''Fey Yoshida''' used an Rthro package. It had grey skin, pink hair, purple cap and white headphones. It wore a green to blue fade jacket, and had a purple shirt and pants. It also wore black shoes. '''Fey Yoshida''' was seen doing the [[Praisin]] emote while moving. ==Strategy== *The [[Minigunner]] can easily defeat '''Fey Yoshida'''. **Placing many [[Scout]]s and [[Sniper]]s can also be effective. *The [[Rocketeer]] may be useful in clearing other enemies that spawn alongside '''Fey Yoshida''', though its poor single target damage makes it ineffective against '''Fey Yoshida''' itself. *You can allow '''Fey Yoshida''' to get to the end, provided you have enough health remaining when the wave ends. *Do note that you can use the {{Color|Golden}} skins of the provided towers to aid you. ==Trivia== *'''Fey Yoshida''' is one of the opposing teams to AJ in the [[Metaverse Champions Event]], hence why it is referred to as AJ's "''arch nemesis''". *'''Fey Yoshida''' is the first enemy to use an entirely Roblox made package, the second being the [[Korblox Deathwalker (The Hunt)|Korblox Deathwalker]]. *'''Fey Yoshida''' is the only enemy that does an emote while moving. **In this case, the emote being used is [[Praisin]]. ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Fey Yoshida''' added. *'''8 May 2021'''- [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0a]] **Health decreased from 400 to 300. *'''16 May 2021'''- [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.1]] **'''Fey Yoshida''' removed. {{CyberCity|[[Hidden]]|Wave 9|Fey Yoshida|Wave 10|N/A|End}} {{ZombieNavBox}} __NOTOC__
